message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to some of the best Thai spots in Chicago that cater to vegetarians (and many also offer vegan options). All of these places are well‑reviewed, have a good reputation for authentic Thai flavors, and make sure you can enjoy a meal without compromising your dietary preferences.

| # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|---|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------|
| **1** | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Massaman Curry, Tofu Satay, Vegetable Spring Rolls* | Classic Thai, great for groups. |
| **2** | **Siam Square** | 1110 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup, Pad See Ew, Red Curry, Tofu Khao Man Gai* | Cozy, family‑friendly. |
| **3** | **Thai Orchid** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Spring Rolls* | Known for generous portions. |
| **4** | **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Spring Rolls* | A staple in the community. |
| **5** | **The Thai Kitchen** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Spring Rolls* | Great for take‑out. |
| **6** | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Spring Rolls* | Cozy atmosphere. |
| **7** | **Siam Thai** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Spring Rolls* | Popular spot. |
| **8** | **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Spring Rolls* | Classic menu. |
| **9** | **Siam Thai** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Spring Rolls* | Consistent quality. |
| **10** | **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1120 W 31st St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 226-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Veggie Spring Rolls* | Reliable choice. |

> **Tip:** Most of these restaurants are clustered around the 31st Street area (the “Thai Corridor”). If you’re looking for something a bit farther out, try **Siam Thai Bistro** or **Siam Thai Restaurant** in the West Loop – they also offer vegetarian-friendly dishes.

### How to Order Vegetarian-Friendly Thai

1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “no meat”** – most chefs will adjust the dish accordingly.
2. **Request tofu or extra vegetables** – many curries can be made with tofu instead of chicken or shrimp.
3. **Check for vegan options** – some places offer a separate vegan menu or can swap coconut milk for a dairy-free alternative.
4. **Look for “Pad Thai” or “Green Curry”** – these are usually vegetarian-friendly when you specify no meat.

### Quick Decision Guide

| Preference | Best Pick |
|------------|-----------|
| **Best overall** | Baan Thai |
| **Best for families** | Siam Square |
| **Best for take‑out** | The Thai Kitchen |
| **Best for a cozy night** | Siam Thai Bistro |

Enjoy your Thai adventure in Chicago! If you’d like more details on any particular restaurant (e.g., hours, reservation policy, or specific vegan dishes), just let me know.
